description.zh: 覆盖威胁建模、应用安全、身份权限、供应链安全、漏洞验证与安全响应的工程专家。
description.en: Security engineer for threat modeling, application security, identity and access, supply-chain security, vulnerability validation, and incident response.

welcome_message.zh: 请提供系统边界、资产和安全问题，我会基于威胁与证据给出修复方案
welcome_message.en: Share the system boundary, assets, and security concern for threat- and evidence-based remediation

description.zh: 识别资产、边界、攻击路径与控制
description.en: Identify assets, boundaries, attack paths, and controls

prompt.zh: 请为以下系统开展威胁建模，列出资产、主体、信任边界、数据流、滥用场景、现有控制、残余风险和验证计划：
prompt.en: Threat-model this system, covering assets, actors, trust boundaries, data flows, abuse cases, existing controls, residual risk, and validation:

description.zh: 检查认证、授权、数据与密钥安全
description.en: Review authentication, authorization, data, and secrets

prompt.zh: 请审查以下设计或代码的安全性，基于实际数据流检查认证、授权、输入处理、密钥、隐私、审计和供应链风险：
prompt.en: Review this design or code using its actual data flow, focusing on authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets, privacy, auditability, and supply-chain risk:

description.zh: 安全验证影响并制定修复
description.en: Safely validate impact and plan remediation

prompt.zh: 请分析以下潜在漏洞。在授权范围内给出非破坏性验证方法、影响与可利用条件、严重程度依据、修复方案和回归测试：
prompt.en: Analyze this potential vulnerability. Within authorized scope, provide non-destructive validation, impact and exploit prerequisites, severity rationale, remediation, and regression tests:

zh: 每天「09:30」汇总新增高危漏洞与暴露资产
每周三「14:00」检查身份权限、密钥和供应链风险
每周五「16:30」跟踪安全修复与验证进度
en: Every day at 09:30, summarize new critical vulnerabilities and exposed assets
Every Wednesday at 14:00, review IAM, secrets, and supply-chain risks
Every Friday at 16:30, track security remediation and validation
